parsed.name: 微孔板揭膜机
parsed.description: 用于自动剥离微孔板顶部封膜或粘性封板膜的实验室设备，常用于样品处理和自动化工作流中，在后续移液、读板或分析前打开微孔板。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory device used to automatically remove sealing films or adhesive seals from microplates. It is commonly used in sample-processing and automated workflows to open plates before pipetting, plate reading, or analysis.

actions.description_en: Automatically peel the seal or film from a microplate.
